g.text: VESPER Complete Distributed System Architecture & Multi-Agent Swarm Specification
Data Persistence, Vector Memory & Cloud Services
- Piper ONNX offline TTS audio playback
- Pre-empts ongoing LLM / TTS on speech
- Audio I/O offloaded to least-capable node
- Heavy Swarm & Vision retained on workstation
- Screen Capture: Active monitor desktop buffer
Zero token cost, sub-turn intent dispatch
- Personality: Dry, witty, concise British butler
- Strips markdown code blocks for audio
- Emits HUD card payloads to UI
set_reminder(reminder: string, time: string, priority: string)
schedule_event(summary: string, start_time: string, end_time: string)
play_track(query: string, artist: string, device: string)
web_search(query: string, search_depth: string, max_results: integer)
log_transaction(amount: number, type: string, category: string, description: string, account_name: string)
split_expense(total_amount: number, people: array, description: string)
manage_debt(action: string, person: string, amount: number, description: string)
manage_financial_goal(action: string, name: string, target_amount: number, current_amount: number, deadline: string)
get_code_snippet(path: string, repo: string, start_line: integer, end_line: integer, ref: string)
solve_doubt(query: string, path: string, code: string, repo: string)
list_issues(repo: string, state: string, limit: integer)
draft_email(to: string, subject: string, body: string)
send_email(to: string, subject: string, body: string)
read_thread(thread_id: string, email_id: string, query: string)
- Increments silent badge for bulk alerts
- Triggers audio interrupt only for VIP / Urgent
Channels: CONTROL | VOICE | GESTURE | NOTIFY | SYSTEM | SYNC
